rules: Reduces its size to Tiny; its lowest-reach melee Strikes get reach 0 feet and longer-reach ones reach 5 feet; adds Stealth equal to its highest skill modifier and Scamper Underfoot.

abilities.name: Scamper Underfoot
abilities.description: {Name} Strides twice. It can pass through the space of creatures larger than itself during this movement, and its movement does not trigger reactions.
